description: Pre-validated safe versions for autonomous CWE-937 remediation. All versions tested in Barclays BUK ecosystem and confirmed available in internal Nexus.

log4j:log4j.notes: 100% API-compatible with log4j 1.2.17. No code changes required. PatternLayout subclasses (e.g., PatternLayoutIBank) continue to work. Backports CVE-2019-17571, CVE-2021-4104, CVE-2022-23302.

org.bouncycastle:bcprov-jdk15on.notes: bcprov-jdk15on is end-of-life. bcprov-jdk18on is the current supported artifact (Java 8+). The artifact rename is part of the fix — bcprov-jdk18on:1.85 patches multiple CVEs (CVE-2026-59650, CVE-2026-12860, CVE-2026-12816, CVE-2026-13506, CVE-2026-59649, etc.). Compatible with JDK 8, 11, 17, and 21+. Available in Barclays internal Nexus.

org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-core.notes: Patches Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228) and related RCE vulnerabilities. Requires log4j-api:2.24.0 (always paired). If codebase uses org.apache.log4j.* imports, add log4j-1.2-api:2.24.0 bridge. Also patches WVE-2026-007 and other deserialization vulnerabilities. Supports upgrades from all pre-safe versions (2.14.1, 2.17.2, etc.) to 2.24.0.

org.springframework:spring-webmvc.notes: Patches Spring4Shell (CVE-2022-22965) and related RCE. Same major.minor (5.3.x) ensures backward compatibility. Java 8-11 compatible.

org.apache.commons:commons-text.notes: Patches Text4Shell (CVE-2022-42889). Minimal version jump, same major version (1.x). No API breaking changes.

com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-datab.notes: Patches deserialization gadget vulnerabilities (CVE-2022-42003, CVE-2022-42004). MUST pair with jackson-core:2.19.4 and jackson-annotations:2.19.4 (enforce same version). Use resolutionStrategy.force for static scanner visibility.

io.netty:netty-codec.notes: Patches HTTP request smuggling (CWE-444). Same major.minor branch (4.1.x) ensures compatibility.

org.yaml:snakeyaml.notes: Patches unsafe deserialization (CWE-502). Major version bump but stable API. Disable unsafe deserialization by default in 2.x (more secure).

org.glassfish.jersey.core:jersey-common.notes: In-place upgrade. MUST apply same version to all org.glassfish.jersey.* artifacts (jersey-server, jersey-client, jersey-core, etc.).

org.apache.tomcat.embed:tomcat-embed-cor.notes: Patches critical Tomcat CVEs including CVE-2026-41293, CVE-2025-24813, CVE-2026-43512, CVE-2026-43515. Java 8+ compatible. 9.0.121 is latest available; 9.0.119, 9.0.120 also available if needed.

com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-core.notes: Patches deserialization gadgets. Java 8+ compatible. MUST pair with jackson-databind:2.18.10 and jackson-annotations:2.18.10 (enforce same version across all three artifacts). Use resolutionStrategy.force for static scanner visibility.

com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-datab.notes: Patches deserialization gadget vulnerabilities. Java 8+ compatible. MUST pair with jackson-core:2.18.10 and jackson-annotations:2.18.10 (enforce same version). Use resolutionStrategy.force for static scanner visibility.

org.springframework:spring-beans.notes: Patch-level upgrade within Spring 5.2.x. Java 8+ compatible. Addresses Spring CVEs while maintaining backward compatibility.

org.springframework:spring-core.notes: Patch-level upgrade within Spring 5.2.x. Java 8+ compatible. Addresses Spring CVEs while maintaining backward compatibility.

org.springframework:spring-context.notes: Patch-level upgrade within Spring 5.2.x. Java 8+ compatible. Addresses Spring CVEs while maintaining backward compatibility.

log4j_migration_1x_to_2x.description: When Log4j 1.x must migrate to 2.x (not reload4j)
log4j_migration_1x_to_2x.trigger: User specifies 2.x is required OR reload4j compatibility issues detected
log4j_migration_1x_to_2x.strategy: Exclude log4j 1.x globally, add log4j-core + log4j-api + conditional bridges
steps: Check src/ for 'import org.apache.log4j.*' — if found, add log4j-1.2-api:2.23.1
Check build.gradle for 'slf4j-log4j12' — if found, replace with log4j-slf4j2-impl:2.23.1
log4j_migration_1x_to_2x.notes: Not auto-selected; requires hybrid or manual review flag

exclusions.description: Libraries that should be handled as dependency type (corrective action) not auto-fix
exclusions.reason: Major migration, multiple strategies, or org-specific decision required

packages.name: com.sun.jersey:*

packages.name: org.jvnet.mimepull:mimepull
packages.reason: GPL-2.0 licensed; may need replacement or version bump coordination with JAXB.
